## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (tsc, unit, i18n, steps, quality gates, changelog)
- [ ] No new duplication (`pnpm dedup`); reused existing helpers / `AdaptiveSheet` / the single prefs location
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `spec/features` and `e2e/STEPS.md` updated if behaviour or steps changed
- [ ] A `feat` or `fix` adds a plain "What's new" line to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Conventional commit messages
